title: Russia loses 2,471 troops, three multiple rocket launchers in Ukraine war over past day

title: Ukrainian community in US seeking to build strong ties with newly elected members of Congress
summary: The Ukrainian community and civic activists in the United States should establish contacts with newly elected members of Congress as soon as possible to secure their support for Ukraine, says Andriy Dobriansky, an expert at the Center for US-Ukrainian Relations.
